propositions: Pass-1 finder (which generates blocking findings) silently downgraded from claude-opus-4-8 (frontier) to claude-haiku-4-5 (trivial) after commit 4beec08a4 on 2026-06-27, weakening the claim gate without alarm or test coverage.

The regression is empirically verified: sidecar records show 115 plan-review runs generating findings on opus before 2026-06-27, then zero opus runs and 2,710+ sonnet runs immediately after that commit, indicating a total permanent changeover.

Commit b690 enables req.config to influence Pass-1 for the first time by making PydanticAIRunner honor request-level config; combined with plan-review.yaml's model_ladder rung 0 set to 'trivial', this deepens the regression rather than healing it.

Pass-1 declares a model_ladder but the declaration has been unreachable until b690 landed; the fix requires setting rung 0 to 'frontier' (opus) to restore pre-regression behavior, as 'standard' (sonnet) would ratify the bug.

The prerequisite finder's bin packing uses cfg.model which is now haiku instead of opus, changing context-limit escalation behavior and burning tokens on unnecessary escalations that previously stayed within window.
